_comment: Optional. Copy to grading.json. Per-course grading rules from each syllabus, keyed by course code; used to estimate a current grade before the LMS shows one. `scale` = letter -> minimum percent. `categories` replaces the gradebook's own weighting (omit it when the gradebook already matches the syllabus). `match` is a case-insensitive regex tried on the item name, then its gradebook category. `count` = items that will count at term end (after drops). `quizLog` reads hand-kept quiz scores from a Markdown file in the library (see src/lib/school/quizlog.ts).
